title: The Craziest Vibe Coded Project I've Ever Seen
description:
Did PewDiePie actually build a ChatGPT competitor?

Felix dropped $41,000 on an insane local AI rig and built his own open-source AI workspace with zero prior coding knowledge. While the internet is calling it a ChatGPT competitor, it’s actually something much more important: a completely private, self-hosted interface that keeps your data OUT of the hands of Big Tech companies. 

It’s one of the greatest examples of what open-source AI and "vibe coding" makes possible today.

👇 What’s the most questionable AI claim you’ve seen lately? Drop it below and I’ll try to debunk it in the next video!

#AI #PewDiePie #ChatGPT #vibecoding
